topic: Updating SQL for production frequency comparison
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on modifying a shared SQL script to correctly pull data from the PROD dataset. Specifically, [p1] requested changes to ensure that `traffic` and `locations_data` are sourced from the production environment by updating the relevant parameters.

Additionally, [p1] asked for a new line of code to be inserted into the SQL script (around lines 53-25). This addition is intended to calculate and compare frequency data between the production (`frequencyProd`) and staging environments.
decisions: The SQL script will be updated to pull `traffic` and `locations_data` from the PROD dataset.
action_items: Someone needs to insert the specified frequency comparison line into the SQL script (around lines 53-25).
